method: No Playwright routing/interception. Serial same-profile Edge cold/warm pairs; cold=fresh browser context+CDP clearBrowserCache, cache enabled; warm=same page normal second navigation with HTTP cache retained. Native network, CPU1x; desktop1440x900 DPR1, touch390x844 DPR1.75. Local immutable Git8c bytes with max-age600/ETag/gzip policy. JS/GL wrappers are read-only timing probes, not GPU execution timers. Reverse origin order in round2. Browser/driver shader caches not cleared.
